api_inventory.method: go doc -all over root pterm and putils packages plus manual signature review

excluded: live printers and terminal cursor state
timing, process exit, and concurrent global printer registries
risk_adaptation.determinism: The public bridge explicitly enables or disables color before every color-sensitive call.
risk_adaptation.boundary: Only JSON-safe strings, numbers, booleans, style codes, and value snapshots cross the subprocess bridge.
risk_adaptation.limits: The bridge accepts at most 128 KiB per newline-delimited request.

private_assertion_classes: plain fmt-compatible formatting and control prefixes
ANSI color constants, rendering, line splitting, and disable behavior
style composition, removal, ordering, and nested reset behavior
basic text zero value and configured style
short and long hexadecimal RGB parsing and invalid input
Unicode code-point letter splitting and supplied style/RGB propagation
